items.name: c-tree-1
items.title: Basic tree.
items.descriptionLong: Basic tree. Built with the Tree component. Uses @headless-tree/core, @headless-tree/react alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn tree example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-tree-1 and edit as your own code.
